# HEM v0.8.1 — Room conditions at a glance

The room settings cog now sits immediately before the room name. Condition faces follow the name. Device activity, information, warnings and errors appear on the right. Readings and trends stay on the second row. Alerts wrap on narrow cards and retain their individual actions.

- 😊 Within the comfort band · 🥶 cold · 🥵 hot · 😓 humid · 😮‍💨 dry · 😷 poor indoor air quality · 😶 insufficient data.
- Several faces can appear together. Expand a room for the labels in your interface language. The faces only describe measurements.
- Temperature, humidity, air-quality and average icons are vertically centered beside their values on desktop and mobile.
- The thermal face uses an available PMV estimate first, then HEM’s adaptive comfort estimate, then a simple 20–26 °C display range. Dry means below 30% relative humidity. The humid face uses the indoor humidity warning threshold (65% by default). The air-quality face uses evaluated indoor pollutant exceedances. Outdoor weather warnings and device faults have their own icons.

## Also included since v0.8.0

- Optional distance-based arrival preparation and nearby-home occupancy, with independent radii.
- Warnings for unavailable window contacts while equipment continues to use the remaining verified contacts.
- Fresh PID cycles after target changes, pauses and reconnection. Adaptive calibration retains completed evidence per mode and requires feedback that the equipment actually operated.
- Post-shutdown heater monitoring considers sunlight, neighboring rooms, competing heaters and residual heat before notifying or retrying OFF.

**Upgrading from v0.8.0:** If a manually configured dashboard still uses `custom:air-quality-advisor-card`, change its type to `custom:home-environment-manager-card`. Update through HACS, restart Home Assistant and refresh the dashboard.
